usd.sub: Aave v3 on Polygon. One signature, no POL needed.
usd.mainnetOnly: Dollars always run on Polygon mainnet, also while Nimiq Pay is on testnet.
usd.connectLede: See what your dollars on Polygon could earn, and what they already do.
usd.tooLittle: Deposits start at {min}. Your wallet holds {balance} on Polygon.
usd.risk.title: Before you deposit
usd.risk.protocolV: Aave v3 on Polygon, reached through Accrue's router: open source, no owner, and it can only send funds back to your own wallet.
usd.risk.rateV: Today {usdt} on USDT and {usdc} on USDC. It follows how much people borrow, block by block, and nothing here promises it.
usd.risk.wrongV: A bug in Aave or in the router could lose funds. If a reserve is fully lent out, withdrawals wait until borrowers repay.
usd.risk.exitV: One signature, usually under a minute. Right now Aave can pay out {usdt} and {usdc} at once.
usd.src: Rates and liquidity read from the Aave pool on Polygon at {time}.
usd.srcDown: Aave's numbers are not available right now.
amount.allNote: Everything, including the interest that accrues until it lands.
amount.hintSupply: In your wallet: {balance}. From {min} to {max} per deposit.
amount.format: Use digits and one decimal point, like 12.50.
amount.formatComma: Use digits and one decimal separator, like 12,50 or 12.50.
amount.balance: That is more than the {balance} in your wallet.
amount.position: That is more than the {balance} you have in Aave.
sheet.intro.supply: Next you see exactly what you sign before Nimiq Pay asks.
sheet.intro.withdraw: Withdrawals go back to the wallet they came from, nowhere else.
sheet.sign.supply: A permit for exactly {amount}, valid for {minutes} minutes. It is a signature, not a transaction, and moves nothing by itself.
sheet.sign.withdraw: A permit on your Aave {token} position for {amount}, valid for {minutes} minutes. It is a signature, not a transaction.
sheet.next.supply: Accrue's relayer sends one transaction that puts it into Aave v3 in your name. Your {token} then grows every second. Usually under a minute.
sheet.next.withdraw: Accrue's relayer sends one transaction that takes it out of Aave straight to your wallet. Usually under a minute.
sheet.gas: Paid by Accrue. You need no POL.
sheet.usdt0Chain: Nimiq Pay will show "Chain: undefined" for this signature. That is expected: USDT0's permit names Polygon with a salt instead of a chain id, so the signature still only works on Polygon.
sheet.step.switchSub: Your wallet is on another network. This is its own tap; nothing is signed yet.
sheet.st.signingSub: Confirm in Nimiq Pay. Cancelling there sends nothing.
sheet.st.sendingSub: Signed. If the connection drops, the same signature is sent again; you are never asked twice.
sheet.st.submittedSub: Waiting for the block. You can close this; it keeps going and shows up in Activity.
sheet.st.checkingSub: We have not heard back whether it went through. We keep checking, and pick it up again when you reopen the app. Nothing new is sent until this is settled.
sheet.st.relayerDown: Accrue's relayer is not reachable right now.
sheet.selfGas: Pay the network fee myself, up to {fee} POL
sheet.st.earningSub: {amount} is in Aave and earns from this block on.
sheet.st.backSub: {amount} left Aave for your wallet on Polygon.
sheet.st.elsewhere: Your permit was used on Polygon, so this is done. We could not see which transaction carried it.
sheet.st.cancelledSub: You declined in Nimiq Pay. No signature left your phone.

stake.testnet: Nimiq Pay is on testnet: balances and pools here are testnet NIM. Dollars stay on Polygon mainnet.
stake.connectLede: See your stake, your pool's record and what is idle.
stake.noneSub: {amount} can be staked now. The network's minimum is 100 NIM.
stake.unlisted: A pool not on the public list
stake.step.retireSub: One tap, once the wait is over.
stake.step.removeSub: One tap; it lands in your wallet.
stake.compound.title: What compounding adds
stake.compound.why: Your pool pays to your wallet, so rewards sit idle until you stake them. Staked, they earn too. Estimated from what your pool paid you over the last 7 days; the rate varies.
stake.fee: Any network fee is shown in Nimiq Pay before you confirm. Accrue takes nothing.
stake.to: The Nimiq staking contract, {contract}. Your NIM stays yours; the pool only stakes with it.
stake.sign.stake: A staking transaction: {amount} from your Nimiq Pay wallet, delegated to {pool}.
stake.sign.add: A staking transaction adding {amount} to your stake with {pool}.
stake.sign.deactivate: A staking transaction that stops {amount} from earning.
stake.sign.switch: A staking transaction that moves your whole stake to {pool}.
stake.sign.remove: A transaction that sends {amount} from the staking contract back to your wallet.
stake.next.stake: It joins {pool}'s stake. The pool {payouts}. Getting it back later takes 12 to 24 hours.
stake.next.deactivate: The network releases it 12 to 24 hours later. Then one tap unlocks it and one more sends it to your wallet. It earns nothing while it waits.
stake.next.switch: It earns with {pool} from then on.
stake.next.retire: One more tap sends it to your wallet.
stake.next.remove: It is in your wallet once the network confirms it, usually within a minute.
stake.alreadyStopped: This amount has already stopped earning. The next steps are on the NIM screen.
stake.done.deactivate: {amount} stopped earning; the wait has started
stake.done.remove: {amount} is on its way to your wallet
stake.sw.waiting: Your stake has stopped earning. Come back when the wait is over to move it.

check.boardTestnet: Testnet pools from the Nimiq testnet validators API. No payout record.
check.noVerdict: No verdict yet: not enough payouts in the window to say either way.
act.title: Activity
act.empty: Nothing yet. Deposits, withdrawals and staking show up here with a link to the chain.

about.title: About Accrue
about.sub: Risks, what is stored, and how the checks work.
about.risk.contract.body: Your dollars sit in Aave v3 on Polygon, reached through Accrue's router. A bug in either could lose funds. Aave v3 is audited and has run on Polygon since 2022; the router is small, has no owner and is open source.
about.risk.rate.body: Aave's rate follows demand to borrow. It moves every block, up or down. Nothing here promises a rate.
about.risk.exit.body: If a reserve is fully lent out, withdrawals wait until borrowers repay or new deposits come in. The Dollars screen shows how much can leave right now.
about.risk.unstake.body: Unstaked NIM is released once the current epoch ends and an epoch has passed. It earns nothing while it waits.
about.risk.pools.body: The network pays the pool, not you. The pool decides when and how much to pass on. Payout Check can show a pool falling short; it cannot make it pay.
about.data.phoneBody: Your NIM and Polygon addresses, your Accrue actions while they are on their way, and one snapshot of your balances for "since your last visit".
about.data.serverBody: The addresses you act with and your relay jobs, so they can be sent and tracked. Public pool and Aave data. No names, no device data.
about.data.neverBody: No tracking, no analytics, no cookies, no keys. Accrue cannot move your funds anywhere but back to you.
about.methodBody: For each pool, Accrue's indexer adds up what the network paid the pool over 7 days and what the pool passed on to its stakers, the way it says it pays. For you, it compares what your stake should have earned after the fee with what reached you. Verdicts stay neutral and wait for enough data:
about.pendingDesc: The API has no verdict for this pool or address yet.
about.sourceBody: Accrue's app, server and router are MIT licensed. Every number on screen names where it comes from.
